pages.title: Healing
pages.text: $(bold)Necklace:$() grants Regeneration.$(br2)$(bold)Bangle / Ring:$() heals the target (or yourself) and grants Regeneration. With an aim cut into it, the mending also runs as a line in that direction, tending everything standing along it.$(br2)$(bold)Cooldown:$() 3.0s per cast.$(br2)$(bold)Held by:$() Engravable Diamond, Engravable Emerald, Engravable Glowstone.
